beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Before you were born, you agreed to terms that should scare you. Forget everything. Walk blind. Risk sin, and pain, and death. Why would anyone sign that — and why would a loving Father offer it?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Start with the forgetting. A veil was drawn across your memory — heaven, the council, His face. Not as a punishment. As the whole point.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Because the test could never work in plain sight. A God standing visibly in the room does not get chosen — He gets complied with. And compliance was Lucifer's plan.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The veil is what makes your choices mean something. Down here you cannot lean on the memory of His face. You have to decide what you love — when love is all you have to go on.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: For we walk by faith, not by sight.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Faith is things which are hoped for and not seen; wherefore, dispute not because ye see not, for ye receive no witness until after the trial of your faith.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So the silence you sometimes feel is not absence. It is the exam room being kept honest. He is closer than the veil feels. And the veil is thinner than you think.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But forgetting was the smaller risk. Here is the bigger one: down here, everyone sins. Everyone dies. If the story ended there, mortality would be a trap, not a school.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So before the first breath was ever drawn — before Adam, before Eden, before the earth itself — the rescue was already signed.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: The Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: The precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot: who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Foreordained before the foundation of the world. The Savior was never God's backup plan after Eden went wrong. He was the load-bearing beam of the original blueprint. The plan was never hope they don't fall. It was: they will fall — and I will catch every single one who lets me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is why heaven let you take the risk at all. You did not go down uninsured. Your Father let you fall only because your Brother had already promised to catch you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So read the terms again. Forget — so your love can be real. Fall — with the rescue pre-paid. Walk blind — with a hand you cannot see holding the rail beside you the whole way down.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You signed those terms once, with a shout of joy. Somewhere behind the veil, you knew exactly what you were doing.

card.speaker: narrator
card.text: You did not come here uninsured. The rescue was signed before the risk began.
